headline: Ueno Bank case: Paraguay's banking superintendent detained and presidential residence raided
summary: Paraguay's banking superintendent Holger Insfrán was detained and the presidential residence was raided, both ordered by the Prosecutor's Office. Paraguay has begun returning part of savings to those harmed by Ueno Bank under an emergency congressional measure.
why: Ueno Bank's collapse and the regulator's response affect depositor confidence and the stability of Paraguay's banking system. The superintendent oversees the country's banks.
